hub_lead: Play an engine that explains its moves, solve puzzles at your level, study tactics and openings.
tile_play_text: Stockfish with 8 strength levels. After every move you make, the coach tells you whether it was best and what to play instead.
tile_puzzles_text: 50,000 positions from the Lichess database, matched to your rating
tile_learn_text: 15 tactical motifs and 20 openings with their ideas explained
bad_fen: Couldn't open the position from the link, starting a regular game.
end_threefold: Draw: the position repeated three times.
end_insufficient: Draw: not enough material to checkmate.
opt_auto_hint: The coach explains every mistake or blunder on its own. Uses your daily explanation limit.
opt_hints_hint: Arrows on the board: the bolder, the better the move.
coach_duo: Two players at one board — I'm just watching. Pick “Engine” and I'll go through every move with you.
tile_online_text: An opponent at your level, the time control you like
tile_friend_text: Create a game and send your friend the link
tile_storm_text: 3 or 5 minutes against the clock: each puzzle is harder, a mistake costs 10 seconds
ng_online_lead: We will find an opponent near your rating. Pick a time control: minutes per game + seconds per move.
ng_friend_lead: Create a game and send the link to a friend — the first person to open it becomes your opponent.
ng_login: Playing a friend needs an account.
ng_error: Could not create the game. Please try again.
ng_duo_lead: One screen for two: take turns, flip the board when you like. The coach stays quiet in this game.
opt_confirm_hint: A move is played only after you press “Confirm” — guards against misclicks.
coach_off: The coach is off — a clean game. Turn it on in “New game”.
ng_specials_guest: Sign in — special bots unlock with rewards for playing.
